description: This file provides support for sending voice messages via Discord's API, including functions for processing audio files (duration, waveform, format conversion) and uploading them as voice messages with specific flags and metadata.

methods.name: createRateLimitError
methods.description: Creates a RateLimitError object based on Discord API response and request details.

methods.name: getAudioDuration
methods.description: Uses ffprobe to determine the duration of an audio file.

methods.name: generateWaveform
methods.description: Generates waveform data from an audio file, falling back to a placeholder if extraction fails.

methods.name: generateWaveformFromPcm
methods.description: Extracts raw PCM data from an audio file and samples it to produce waveform data.

methods.name: generatePlaceholderWaveform
methods.description: Creates a simple sine-wave-like placeholder waveform.

methods.name: ensureOggOpus
methods.description: Converts an audio file to OGG/Opus format at 48kHz if necessary.

methods.name: getVoiceMessageMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves duration and waveform metadata for a voice message.

methods.name: sendDiscordVoiceMessage
methods.description: Uploads a voice message to Discord and sends it as a message with appropriate flags and metadata.
